sanskrit: pratīkaṃ me vicakṣaṇam akṣau me madhukāśinī | karṇābhyāṃ bhūrisusravaḥ ||
english: My face is discerning, my eyes are sweet-glancing; through both my ears flows abundant hearing.

sanskrit: jihvā me madhusaṃsrāvā jihvā me madhuvādinī | tayāham adya jihvayā- -udyāsaṃ madhumad vacaḥ ||
english: My tongue pours forth sweetness, my tongue speaks sweetly; with that tongue of mine today may I utter honeyed speech.

sanskrit: yathā madhu madhukṛtaḥ saṃbharanti madhāv adhi | evāham adya chandobhir udyāsaṃ madhumad vacaḥ ||
english: As the honey-makers gather honey upon honey, so today with metres may I utter honeyed speech.

sanskrit: vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa pratyak somo adhiśritaḥ | indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā ||
english: Purified by the purifying filter of Vāyu, Soma is set in place face to face; he is the yokemate and friend of Indra.

sanskrit: yat kiñ cedaṃ varuṇa daivye jane abhidrohaṃ manuṣyāś caranti | ati cet tava dharmā yuyopima mā nas tasmād enaso deva rīriṣaḥ ||
english: Whatever transgression, O Varuṇa, mortals commit against the divine folk — if we have overstepped your ordinances in any way, do not injure us, O god, for that sin.

sanskrit: āpo asmān mātaraḥ sūdayantu ghṛtena no ghṛtapavaḥ punantu | viśvaṃ hi ripraṃ pravahanti devīr ud id ābhyaḥ śucir ā pūta emi ||
english: May the Waters as mothers refresh us; may the clarifying-with-ghee ones purify us with ghee. For the divine Waters carry away all defilement; I come forth pure and cleansed from them.

sanskrit: mitraś ca samrāḍ varuṇaś ca rājā tau te bhakṣaṃ kṛṇutāṃ prātar agne | tayor aham anu bhakṣaṃ kṛṇomi sūryavarcā bhaga bhakto na ā viśa ||
english: Both Mitra the sovereign and Varuṇa the king — may they share your portion at the morning pressing, O Agni. I too make my portion after theirs; O Bhaga, enter me endowed with solar splendour.

sanskrit: sūryavarcā na ā viśa viśvavin manasas patiḥ | anehā soma jāgṛvir indraḥ prīta stuto nṛbhiḥ ||
english: Enter us endowed with solar splendour, O all-knowing lord of the mind. Soma, ever-wakeful and blameless, and Indra, gladdened and praised by men.

sanskrit: indra prītasya te vayaṃ śukrasya rocanāvataḥ | bhakṣīmahi prajām iṣaṃ sāhasrasya yaśasvinaḥ ||
english: May we, O Indra, share in your delight, in the brightness and radiance of the gleaming, thousand-fold glorious one — offspring and refreshment.

sanskrit: agniḥ prātaḥsavane pātv asmān vaiśvānaraḥ pathikṛd viśvakṛṣṭiḥ | sa naḥ pāvako draviṇe dadhāty āyuṣmantaḥ sahabhakṣāḥ syāma ||
english: May Agni Vaiśvānara, maker of the path, lord of all peoples, guard us at the morning pressing; may that purifier establish wealth for us. May we be long-lived and share the portion together.

sanskrit: viśve devā maruta indro asmān asmin dvitīye savane na jahyuḥ | āyuṣmantaḥ priyam eṣāṃ vadanto vayaṃ devānāṃ sumatau syāma ||
english: May all the gods, the Maruts, and Indra not forsake us at this second pressing. Speaking what is dear to them and long-lived, may we be in the good favour of the gods.

sanskrit: idaṃ tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ kavīnām ṛtena yac camasaṃ samairayan | saudhanvanā amṛtam ānaśānāḥ sviṣṭin no abhi vasyo nayātha ||
english: This third pressing of the seers, with which through cosmic order they set the cup in motion — the sons of Sudhanvan, having attained immortality, lead us toward well-offered sacrifice and better things.

sanskrit: saṃ saṃ sravantu nadyaḥ saṃ vātāḥ saṃ patatriṇaḥ | yajñam imaṃ vardhayatā giraḥ saṃsrāvyeṇa haviṣā juhomi ||
english: May the rivers flow together, the winds blow together, the birds fly together. Strengthen this sacrifice, O praises; I offer with the jointly-flowing oblation.

sanskrit: imaṃ homā yajñam avata- -imaṃ saṃsrāvaṇā uta | yajñam imaṃ vardhayatā giraḥ saṃsrāvyeṇa haviṣā juhomi ||
english: Guard this sacrifice, O oblations, and also O confluent streams, guard this sacrifice. Strengthen this sacrifice, O praises; I offer with the jointly-flowing oblation.

sanskrit: rūpaṃrūpaṃ vayovayaḥ saṃrabhyainaṃ pari ṣvaje | yajñam imaṃ catasraḥ pradiśo vardhayantu saṃsrāvyeṇa haviṣā juhomi ||
english: Taking hold of every form and every age, I embrace it on all sides. May the four quarters strengthen this sacrifice; I offer with the jointly-flowing oblation.

sanskrit: syūtā devebhir amṛtair na āgann ukhā svasāram adhi me dimasthāt | satyaṃ pūrvā ṛṣayaś cākṛpānā yajñapateḥ su pra tirantv āyuḥ ||
english: The pot sewn together with the immortal gods has come to us; having placed the sister-pot upon me it stood firm. Truly the former seers, having lamented, may they fully extend the life of the lord of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: ukhāṃ sravantīm agadām akarma tvaṣṭā vāyuḥ pṛthivy antarikṣam | yata ścutad dhutam agnau tad astu na tat prāpnoti nirṛtiḥ parastāt ||
english: We have made the flowing pot free of disease — Tvaṣṭṛ, Vāyu, Earth, and Atmosphere. Whatever drips from it and is offered into the fire — let that be; misfortune shall not reach that from beyond.

sanskrit: antar agnāv aścutat stoka eṣa nainaṃ suvātai nirṛtiḥ parastāt | viśvāvasor haviṣo vāvṛdhāno 'yaṃ yajñaḥ sukṛtām etu lokam ||
english: This drop has dripped into the fire; misfortune shall not blow it away from beyond. Waxing strong through the oblation of Viśvāvasu, may this sacrifice go to the world of the well-doers.

sanskrit: śyeno 'si gāyatracchandā anu tvā rabhe svasti mā saṃ pāraya ||
english: You are the eagle of the Gāyatrī metre; I take hold of you after; carry me across to safety.

sanskrit: samrāḍ asi triṣṭupchandā anu tvā rabhe svasti mā saṃ pāraya ||
english: You are the sovereign of the Triṣṭubh metre; I take hold of you after; carry me across to safety.

sanskrit: svaro 'si gayo 'si jagacchandā anu tvā rabhe svasti mā saṃpāraya ||
english: You are the high note, you are the melody of the Jagatī metre; I take hold of you after; carry me across to safety.

sanskrit: trāyamāṇe sarvavide mā pari dehi | sarvavid dvipāc ca sarvaṃ rakṣa catuṣpād yac ca naḥ svam ||
english: O Trāyamāṇā, hand me over to the all-knowing one. O all-knowing one, protect all our bipeds and quadrupeds and whatever is ours.

sanskrit: sarvavid viśvavide mā pari dehi | viśvavid dvipāc ca sarvaṃ rakṣa catuṣpād yac ca naḥ svam ||
english: O all-knowing one, hand me over to the all-seeing one. O all-seeing one, protect all our bipeds and quadrupeds and whatever is ours.

sanskrit: viśvavit kalyāṇyai mā pari dehi | kalyāṇi dvipāc ca sarvaṃ rakṣa catuṣpād yac ca naḥ svam ||
english: O all-seeing one, hand me over to the auspicious one. O auspicious one, protect all our bipeds and quadrupeds and whatever is ours.

sanskrit: kalyāṇi trāyaṃāṇāyai mā pari dehi | trāyamāṇe dvipāc ca sarvaṃ rakṣa catuṣpād yac ca naḥ svam ||
english: O auspicious one, hand me over to Trāyamāṇā. O Trāyamāṇā, protect all our bipeds and quadrupeds and whatever is ours.

sanskrit: vi khana vi ruja vi jahy atraivānākṛtaś cara | sam aham āyuṣā saṃ mayāyuḥ ||
english: Dig out, break apart, destroy — move here freely without harm being done. Let me be united with life-span; let life-span be united with me.

sanskrit: vi khana vi ruja vi jahy atraivānākṛtaś cara | sam ahaṃ varcasā saṃ mayā varcaḥ ||
english: Dig out, break apart, destroy — move here freely without harm being done. Let me be united with brilliance; let brilliance be united with me.

sanskrit: vi khana vi ruja vi jahy atraivānākṛtaś cara | sam ahaṃ tejasā saṃ mayā tejaḥ ||
english: Dig out, break apart, destroy — move here freely without harm being done. Let me be united with radiant energy; let radiant energy be united with me.

sanskrit: vi khana vi ruja vi jahy atraivānākṛtaś cara | sam ahaṃ prajayā saṃ mayā prajā ||
english: Dig out, break apart, destroy — move here freely without harm being done. Let me be united with offspring; let offspring be united with me.

sanskrit: vi khana vi ruja vi jahy atraivānākṛtaś cara | sam ahaṃ paśubhiḥ saṃ mayā paśavaḥ ||
english: Dig out, break apart, destroy — move here freely without harm being done. Let me be united with cattle; let cattle be united with me.

sanskrit: divo reto 'si pṛthivyā nabhyam | nabhyam asi nabhyaṃ mā kṛṇu ||
english: You are the seed of heaven, the navel of earth. You are the navel; make me the navel.

sanskrit: divo reto 'si pṛthivyāḥ śaktiḥ | śaktir asi śaktaye te vidheyam ||
english: You are the seed of heaven, the power of earth. You are power; let the act be done for your power.

sanskrit: divo reto 'si pṛthivyā vittiḥ | vittir asi vittaye te vidheyam ||
english: You are the seed of heaven, the wealth of earth. You are wealth; let the act be done for your wealth.

sanskrit: divo reto 'si pṛthivyāḥ puṣṭiḥ | puṣṭir asi puṣṭaye te vidheyam ||
english: You are the seed of heaven, the nourishment of earth. You are nourishment; let the act be done for your nourishment.

sanskrit: divo reto 'si pṛthivyā bhūtiḥ | bhūtir asi bhūtaye te vidheyaṃ bhūtir asi bhūtāsi bhūyāsam ||
english: You are the seed of heaven, the prosperity of earth. You are prosperity; let the act be done for your prosperity. You are prosperity, you are what has come to be; may I become fully prosperous.

sanskrit: śukro 'si bhrājo 'si | sa yathā tvaṃ bhrājato bhrājo 'sy evāhaṃ bhrājato bhrājyāsam ||
english: You are the bright one, you are the resplendent one. Just as you are resplendent with resplendence, so may I shine with resplendence.

sanskrit: sāyaṃsāyaṃ gṛhapatir no agniḥ prātaḥprātaḥ saumanasasya dātā | vasorvasor vasudhāna edhi vayaṃ tvendhānās tanvaṃ puṣema ||
english: Evening after evening Agni is the lord of our house; morning after morning the giver of benevolence. O wealth-treasury, be rich upon rich; kindling you, may we nourish the body.

sanskrit: prātaḥprātar gṛhapatir no agniḥ sāyaṃsāyaṃ saumanasasya dātā | vasorvasor vasudhāna edhi- -indhānās tvā śataṃ himā ṛdhema ||
english: Morning after morning Agni is the lord of our house; evening after evening the giver of benevolence. O wealth-treasury, be rich upon rich; kindling you, may we prosper a hundred winters.

sanskrit: yo na āviḥ śapati yaś ca stāyad yadi cittyā manyunā yat sapatnaḥ | agniṣ ṭān pāśān pra mumoktu devo yāvayatu śapathām̐ varuṇo dhṛtavrataḥ ||
english: He who openly curses us, he who steals — and a rival who acts with intentional wrath — may divine Agni release those bonds; may Varuṇa, firm in his ordinances, drive curses away.

sanskrit: prāgnaye vācam īraya vṛṣabhāya kṣitīnām | sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
english: Send forth speech to Agni, the bull of the settlements; may he carry us across beyond our enemies.

sanskrit: yaḥ parasyāḥ parāvatas tiro viśvābhirocate | sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
english: He who shines through all things from a far, far distance — may he carry us across beyond our enemies.

sanskrit: yo rakṣāṃsi nijūrvaty agniḥ śukreṇa śociṣā | sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
english: Agni who crushes the demons with his bright flame — may he carry us across beyond our enemies.

sanskrit: yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṃ ca paśyati | sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
english: He who looks out over all the worlds and sees them together — may he carry us across beyond our enemies.

sanskrit: madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ | mādhvīr gāvo bhavantu naḥ ||
english: The winds blow sweet to the righteous one; the rivers pour forth sweetness; may the cows be sweet-giving for us.

sanskrit: madhu naktam utoṣaso madhumat pārthivaṃ rajaḥ | mādhvīr naḥ santv oṣadhīḥ ||
english: The night is sweet, and so too the dawns; sweet is the earthly atmosphere; may the plants be sweet for us.

sanskrit: madhumān no vanaspatir madhumām̐ astu sūryaḥ | madhu dyaur astu naḥ pitā ||
english: May the lord of the forest be sweet for us; may the sun be sweet; may heaven, our father, be sweet.

sanskrit: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvas tā na ūrje dadhātana | mahe raṇāya cakṣase ||
english: For you, O Waters, are the sources of well-being — grant us strength for great joy and seeing.

sanskrit: yo vaḥ śivatamo rasas tasya bhājayateha naḥ | uśatīr iva mātaraḥ ||
english: Of that most auspicious essence of yours, grant us a share here, like eager mothers.

sanskrit: tasmā araṅgamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha | āpo janayathā ca naḥ ||
english: For that we are ready for you, for whose dwelling you invigorate; O Waters, regenerate us too.

sanskrit: āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnir akramīd asadan mātaraṃ punaḥ | pitaraṃ ca prayaṃtsvaḥ ||
english: This speckled cow has stepped forward and sat down again upon the mother; and at the dawning she meets the father.

sanskrit: asya prāṇād apānaty antaś carati rocanā | vy akhyan mahiṣo divam ||
english: From its in-breath comes the out-breath; the luminous one moves within; the great bull has revealed the sky.

sanskrit: triṃśad dhāma vi rājati vāk pataṅgāya śiśriyat | prati vastor aha dyubhiḥ ||
english: Thirty realms shine out; Speech has clung to the bird; it responds at each dwelling, day after day with its brilliances.

sanskrit: yac chakrā vācam āruhann antarikṣaṃ siṣāsantaḥ | saṃ devā amadan vṛṣā ||
english: When the mighty ones mounted upon Speech, seeking to win the atmosphere, the bull-gods made themselves glad together.

sanskrit: śakro vācam adhiṣṭhāya- -uruvāco asṛṣṭa hi | mahiṣā amadan divi ||
english: Standing upon Speech, the mighty one has released wide-ranging speech; the great bulls made themselves glad in the sky.

sanskrit: śakro vācam asṛṣṭa hi dhāmadharman vi rājati | vimadaṃ barhir ā sarat ||
english: The mighty one has released Speech; it shines out maintaining the abodes. The barhis grass of Vimada has spread forth.
